tools.name: create_posts
tools.title: Create X Post
tools.description: Publish a Post (tweet) as the authenticated user. Provide `text`, and optionally reply to a Post (`reply.in_reply_to_tweet_id`), quote a Post (`quote_tweet_id`), attach uploaded media (`media.media_ids`), or add a poll. Returns the new Post's `id` and `text`. Posts are public unless the account is protected.

community_id.description: Community to post the tweet to.

edit_options.description: Edit an existing tweet rather than creating a new one.

previous_post_id.description: The ID of the Post being edited.

made_with_ai.description: Disclose that the tweet contains AI-generated media.

call_to_actions.description: Call-to-action button rendered on the media entity.

app_install.description: App Install CTA. At least one store id should be provided.

description.description: Description for the media, rendered on the Post card for video and Amplify content.

embeddable.description: When true, the media's asset URLs do not expire and external syndicated playback is allowed.

media_ids.description: Media IDs to attach to the tweet.

preview_media_id.description: Media id whose asset is used as the preview image.

tagged_user_ids.description: User IDs tagged in the media.

title.description: Title for the media, rendered on the Post card for video and Amplify content.

nullcast.description: If true, the tweet is not shown in the public timeline.

paid_partnership.description: Disclose that the tweet is a paid partnership.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the poll in minutes.

reply_settings.description: Who can reply to the poll Tweet. Accepted for compatibility; it carries no backend argument and is dropped before the mutation is issued (see `translate_body`).

auto_populate_reply_metadata.description: If true, reply metadata is automatically populated. Accepted for compatibility; it carries no backend argument and is dropped before the mutation is issued (see `translate_body`).

exclude_reply_user_ids.description: User IDs to exclude from the reply thread.

in_reply_to_tweet_id.description: The ID of the tweet being replied to.

reply_settings.description: Who can reply to this tweet.

share_with_followers.description: Share an exclusive (super-follower) tweet with all followers.

text.description: Text of the Post, up to 280 characters for standard accounts.

data.description: Result returned by X for this action.

errors.description: Partial errors reported by X, if any.

tools.name: get_users_me
tools.title: Get Authenticated X User
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile, including the numeric `id` that other X tools require for user-scoped actions.

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: affiliation, most_recent_post_id, pinned_post_id.

post_fields.description: A comma separated list of Post fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: article, article_title, attachments, card_uri, community_id, context_annotations, conversation_id, created_at, display_text_range, edit_controls, entities, geo, id, lang, matched_media_notes, media_metadata, non_public_metrics, note_post, note_request_suggestions, organic_metrics, paid_partnership, possibly_sensitive, promoted_metrics, public_metrics, reply_settings, scopes, source, suggested_source_links, suggested_source_links_with_counts, text, withheld.

user_fields.description: A comma separated list of User fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: confirmed_email, connection_status, created_at, description, entities, id, is_identity_verified, location, name, parody, profile_banner_url, profile_image_url, protected, public_metrics, receives_your_dm, subscriber_count, subscribes_to_you, subscription, subscription_type, url, username, verified, verified_followers_count, verified_type, withheld.

tools.name: search_posts_recent
tools.title: Search Recent X Posts
tools.description: Search public Posts (tweets) from the last seven days with X search `query` syntax (for example `from:handle`, `#tag`, `-is:retweet`), with pagination. For older Posts, use `search_posts_all`.

end_time.description: Newest UTC timestamp to include, in ISO 8601 format.

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: article.cover_media, article.media_entities, attachments.media_keys, attachments.media_source_tweet, attachments.poll_ids, author_id, edit_history_post_ids, entities.mentions.username, geo.place_id, in_reply_to_user_id, referenced_posts, username.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Between 10 and 100; Default 10.

media_fields.description: A comma separated list of Media fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: alt_text, duration_ms, height, media_key, non_public_metrics, organic_metrics, preview_image_url, promoted_metrics, public_metrics, type, url, variants, width.

place_fields.description: A comma separated list of Place fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: contained_within, country, country_code, full_name, geo, id, name, place_type.

poll_fields.description: A comma separated list of Poll fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: duration_minutes, end_datetime, id, options, voting_status.

post_fields.description: A comma separated list of Post fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: article, article_title, attachments, card_uri, community_id, context_annotations, conversation_id, created_at, display_text_range, edit_controls, entities, geo, id, lang, matched_media_notes, media_metadata, non_public_metrics, note_post, note_request_suggestions, organic_metrics, paid_partnership, possibly_sensitive, promoted_metrics, public_metrics, reply_settings, scopes, source, suggested_source_links, suggested_source_links_with_counts, text, withheld.

query.description: X search query, for example `from:XDevelopers -is:retweet` or `"digital ocean" lang:en`. Up to 512 characters.

since_id.description: Return only results with an ID greater than this Post ID.

start_time.description: Must be within the last 7 days.

until_id.description: Return only results with an ID less than this Post ID.

user_fields.description: A comma separated list of User fields to display. Comma-separated, no spaces; allowed values: confirmed_email, connection_status, created_at, description, entities, id, is_identity_verified, location, name, parody, profile_banner_url, profile_image_url, protected, public_metrics, receives_your_dm, subscriber_count, subscribes_to_you, subscription, subscription_type, url, username, verified, verified_followers_count, verified_type, withheld.
